units.source_text: 夏日猛烈的目光，直射在鹤川和我之间。

en.t: The fierce glare of the summer sun shone straight between Tsurukawa and me.

units.source_text: 鹤川稚嫩的脸闪耀着灿灿的油光，

en.t: Tsurukawa's youthful face gleamed with a bright oily sheen,

units.source_text: 一根根的眼睫毛也燃起金色的光，

en.t: and each of his eyelashes seemed to kindle with golden light,

units.source_text: 从鼻孔呼出的闷热的气扩散开去。

en.t: while the stifling hot breath exhaled from his nostrils spread outward.

units.source_text: 他等待着我结束我的话。

en.t: He waited for me to finish speaking.
